arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_txn FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts the distinct users who have at least one online transaction, going from transactions through cards to users.
assumptions: Counted all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label, since the question does not mention labels.
Period is the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
